description: US Navy Bureau Number 02270. Ditched off Quoin Hill airfield, Efate, Vanuatu on 05/05/1944 after running out of fuel and recovered from the lagoon; believed the oldest surviving Corsair. Long-term static restoration by Bob Jarrett, the centrepiece of the present workshop.
Long-term rebuild; fuselage essentially complete by mid-2024 with wing construction under way. No serial is published for the airframe.
